descriptionText:
The hiring organization is the Agriculture & Consumer Services agency within the N.C. Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services. The Applications Systems Analyst I develops, enhances, maintains, administers, and supports Laboratory Information Management Systems for the Food and Drug Protection Division, and provides application support, training, and problem resolution.
Responsibilities
This position provides full-service application development and support from business process analysis and re-engineering to development and implementation
To provide NCDA&CS with functional software applications that meet their business requirements and provide the services necessary to meet business needs
The work to be performed is identified and prioritized by the Department’s Information Resource Management Committee (IRMC) and is implemented using structured projects and SDLC methodologies
This position is responsible for development, enhancement, maintenance, administration, and support of the Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS) for the Food and Drug Protection Division program carried out in administration of the various division laws
This position is responsible for the development and support of a Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS)
This position supports all the features to each Lab that interface with the LIMS
This position provides proactive problem determination and resolution for LIMS issues
This position is responsible for identifying and recommending needed resources and upgrades for Food & Drug IT solutions
This position also provides computer systems and applications training for the Division
At times, this position will be utilized to assist in other IT projects or issues
Skills
Experience in writing complex SQL queries and stored procedures
Experience programming using VB.net or C#
Experience creating reports using Crystal Reports or SQL Server Reporting Services
Experience in lab environments
Experience supporting Labworks
Bachelor's degree in computer science or an IT related field from an appropriately accredited institution, or Associate degree in computer science or an IT related field or related technical degree from an appropriately accredited institution and one year of experience in business application consulting or development, or High School or General Educational Development (GED) diploma and four years of experience in business application consulting or development; or an equivalent combination of education and experience
Benefits
The position currently qualifies for a telework option. Telework options are subject to change at the discretion of management.
Company Overview
The N.C. It was founded in 2015, and is headquartered in Raleigh, North Carolina, USA, with a workforce of 1001-5000 employees. Its website is https://it.nc.gov.
